_metadata.schema_update: The 2.0 update combined our featured toggle tag list with all other tags, providing a space to ensure tag accuracy; included information now defines tag types and their purpose, any necessary Usage or entry production details, and provides SEO details that can be dynamically populated onto section pages and the homepage, where there are no project entry JSON files to pull that information from.

section.purpose: Predefined top-level grouping of all entries, forming sensible website sections
notes: There are currently four but this could change over time as project skill type grows

sub_section.purpose: Not predefined, these make the section's many entries a bit more manageable by creating a secondary level of upper-level grouping for UX

contextual_tags.located: On project JSON files under `tagging` > broken into four categories
contextual_tags.purpose: Provide hiring manages with exactly the terms they're looking for by creating a comprehensive, storytelling, employment SEO collection of terminology befitting each projects' industry
notes: These are meant to be comprehensive
This overview provides a way to strategically minimize duplicate conceptual terminology across categories
Obvious or implied terminology should be skipped
The grouping categories are meant solely to aid in filling out the project JSON details and are not shown on the front end

categories.(1) TECHNOLOGY: List all temporally relevant or topical technology used in the project
categories.(2) MEDIA: List of media answering where this project lived/s; this is the place the technology and skill met, perhaps what they created there
categories.(3) ROLE: Provided ONE ANSWER ONLY that encompasses the most comprehensive industry term for what the relationship with the project was
categories.(4) SKILL: Remaining list of terminology that a hiring manager would want to know that have not been made clear in technology and media tag category types

featured_content.description: We use TOGGLE TAGS to highlight key generalist skills that hiring managers commonly filter by
featured_content.usage: These tags appear on /web, /print, /digital, /video pages, if they exist on any JSON in that section's entries
notes: They are not a novel tag type, but a highlighting of current tags
Tags must exist as contextual tags (technology, media, skill) in JSON entries to appear
If a toggle tag doesn't exist in a section's entries, it won't be shown
Toggle tags only display on section-type pages, not on click-through contextual tag pages
Order in this array determines display order (left to right after subsection and role tags)

seo_metadata.seo_description: Portfolio of [tag] work prepared and presented in a simple, quick, generalist format that is meant to overcome today's hiring challenges.
seo_metadata.seo_image: [Dynamically pull a single, random thumbnail image from the collection of slideshow thumbnail images for one of the project JSON entries that contain this tag]
